params.lean: [du,dv] displacement from base at y0 to top at y1

features.semantics: Build a closed support from the base point at y0 to an inclined top point/offset at y1. Preserve existing vertical-column behavior when neither top nor lean is supplied. Concrete finish is for support piers; steelWhite is for the slanted white canopy columns.

params.sideGlass: height in metres (0 disables side glazing)

features.semantics: Provide glazed roof panels in a visible white steel frame, optional side glazing, and configurable colour for existing slat canopies. Canopy footprint remains the roof plan; add no unsupported walls or supports—supports are separate Column elements. Keep collider false for non-walkable overhead covers.
Reuse the existing Balustrade type for the plaza perimeter (panel:"bars" or "glass") and the far-edge closed barrier (panel:"solid", height:2.0, collider:true). No new Fence type is needed.

Provide deterministic, simple PBR/kit surface keywords for the evidence-based planting/sand/paving/road areas, without external or non-licensed imagery. Slab top and FloorFinish overlays must use consistent UV/material behavior.

constraints: No Unity scene or asset changes by SkyPlaza; KitExtend8 owns MajibangBuilder.cs and kit-spec.md.
The test spec must pass check_spec and KitValidate with zero errors.
Every roof/frame/pier element is separate so the generator can place physically grounded supports.
